selected.quote: Study the ignition, flame growth, flame spread, and extinction limits for solid fuels burning in low-velocity forced flows in microgravity.
Begin to bridge the gap between the normal gravity NASA-STD-6001 Test #1 method, ground-based microgravity tests, and actual material flammability in microgravity.
Practical, realistic (thicker) fuels in typical geometries will be examined, including slabs, cylinders, and spherical sections.

selected.quote: The FLEX (Flame Extinguishment Experiment) investigation aims to map the flammability limits of liquid fuels in microgravity environments.
The mission seeks to validate and improve simplified models by incorporating detailed chemical reactions, heat transfer, and material movement.
Key flight experiment goals include obtaining high-resolution measurements of droplet burning rates, flame extinction behavior, heat radiation.
